CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the binding between the dataset and the OSS bucket was created. The format is RFC3339Nano
CreateTime.description_zh: 数据集和OSS Bucket绑定关系创建时间的时间戳，格式为RFC3339Nano
CreateTime.title: CreateTime

Phase.description_en:
The scan type. Valid values:

FullScanning: A full scan is in progress.

IncrementalScanning: An incremental scan is in progress
Phase.description_zh:
扫描类型。取值范围如下：

FullScanning：全量扫描中。
IncrementalScanning：增量扫描中
Phase.title: Phase

State.description_en:
The state of the binding between the dataset and the OSS bucket. Valid values:

Ready: The binding is being prepared after it is created.

Stopped: The binding is paused.

Running: The binding is running.

Retrying: The binding is being retried after it is created.

Failed: The binding failed to be created.

Deleted: The binding is deleted
State.description_zh:
数据集和OSS Bucket绑定关系的状态。取值范围如下：

Ready：绑定关系创建后准备中。
Stopped：绑定关系已暂停。
Running：绑定关系运行中。
Retrying：绑定关系创建后重试中。
Failed：绑定关系创建失败。
Deleted：绑定关系已删除
State.title: State

URI.description_en:
The URI of the Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket attached to the dataset.

The format of an OSS bucket URI is `oss://${bucketname}`. The `bucketname` is the name of an OSS bucket that is in the same region as the current project
URI.description_zh:
数据集绑定的对象存储（OSS） Bucket URI。

对象存储（OSS） Bucket URI的格式为`oss://${bucketname}`，其中`bucketname`为和当前项目处于同一地域的OSS Bucket名称
URI.title: URI

UpdateTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the binding between the dataset and the OSS bucket was last modified. The format is RFC3339Nano.

After a binding is created, if the binding has not been paused or restarted, this timestamp is the same as the creation timestamp
UpdateTime.description_zh:
数据集和OSS Bucket的绑定关系修改时间的时间戳，格式为RFC3339Nano。

创建绑定关系后，如果未暂停或者未重启过绑定关系，则绑定关系修改时间的时间戳和绑定关系创建时间的时间戳相同
UpdateTime.title: UpdateTime

description_en: Query the list of bindings between datasets and Object Storage Service (OSS) buckets
description_zh: 查询数据集和对象存储（OSS）Bucket绑定关系列表
name: ListBindings

parameters.help_en: The project name. For information about how to obtain the project name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478153.html
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The dataset name. For information about how to obtain the dataset name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集名称，获取方式请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/478160.html
parameters.name: dataset_name

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of bindings to return. Valid values: 0 to 200.
If this parameter is not set or is set to 0, the default value 100 is used
parameters.help_zh:
返回绑定关系的最大个数，取值范围为0~200。
不设置此参数或者设置为0时，则默认值为100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token that is used when the total number of bindings exceeds the MaxResults value.
Binding information is returned in alphabetical order starting from the NextToken value.
Leave this parameter empty for the first request
parameters.help_zh:
当绑定关系总数大于设置的MaxResults时，用于翻页的token。
从NextToken开始按字典序返回绑定关系信息列表。
第一次调用此接口时，设置为空
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The name of the binding task
parameters.name: name

Bindings.description_en: The list of binding information between datasets and OSS buckets
Bindings.description_zh: 数据集和OSS Bucket绑定关系信息的列表

items.description_en: The information about the binding between a dataset and an OSS bucket
items.description_zh: 数据集和OSS Bucket绑定关系信息的结构体

NextToken.description_en:
The pagination token that is used when the total number of bindings exceeds the MaxResults value.
Use this value as the NextToken in the next request to return the remaining results.
This parameter has a value only when not all bindings are returned
NextToken.description_zh:
当绑定关系总数大于设置的MaxResults时，用于翻页的token。
下一次列出绑定关系信息时以此值为NextToken，将未返回的结果返回。
当绑定关系未全部返回时，此参数才有值
